newsitem.title: USA: Jayhawk president, COO Hoffman resigns.
newsitem.headline: Jayhawk president, COO Hoffman resigns.

text.p: Jayhawk Acceptance Corp said on Thursday it accepted the resignation of Dick Hoffman, its president and chief operating officer.
The financial services company also said a bankruptcy court approved use of its primary lender's cash collateral through March 31 to pay for activities and expenses in a court-approved budget.

The order allows Jayhawk, which has filed under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code, to continue funding its operations while considering alternatives and holding discussions with current and potential lenders.
Jayhawk said its medical finance subsidiary is not a party to the Chapter 11 proceeding and is funding its operations through other sources.
